bajada: Ask ChatGPT or Claude how each client's clips are performing, what's scheduled or how to use Clipfine, with your data and your permissions.
error: Couldn't finish. Connect again from ChatGPT or Claude.

url.texto: Paste it once in ChatGPT or Claude when you add a custom connector.

pasos.p1: In ChatGPT or Claude, add a custom connector and paste the URL.
pasos.p2: It asks you to sign in to Clipfine: sign in with your account and click Allow.
pasos.p3: Done: ask, for example, "which Café Luna clips did best this month?".

soloLectura: Connected apps can only read: they don't schedule, approve or change anything.

aprobar.titulo: {app} wants to connect to your Clipfine
aprobar.texto: If you allow it, {app} will be able to look up, with your permissions:

puede.metricas: Their metrics and what they have scheduled.

aprobar.noPuede: Read only: it can't schedule, approve, edit or delete anything.
aprobar.revocar: You can disconnect it anytime from Profile → Connect to ChatGPT or Claude.

estado.ayudaINACTIVA: It hasn't been used in over a week. If you removed it in ChatGPT or Claude, disconnect it here too.
estado.ayudaVENCIDA: 60 days went by without use. To use it again, connect it again from ChatGPT or Claude.

equipo.texto: Who on the team connected ChatGPT or Claude: they can ask them about this brand’s metrics and schedule, read-only.
equipo.ninguna: No one on the team has connected them yet.
equipo.nota: Each person disconnects their own from Profile. If someone shouldn’t see this brand anymore, remove them from the team: the connector uses the same permissions as the dashboard.
